description: About 5 s after Dana revokes Kevin's membership, Kevin's open board is replaced by the signed-out screen: "This browser isn't signed in to your local Pardner client. Ask your agent to open Pardner for you…". His browser session is still valid; only one project's membership ended. Clicking Check again then shows the correct "Project access revoked; local data remains saved" screen. Repeated twice.
expected: The board shows the project-specific revoked state ("Dana removed you from Atlas Mobile. Your local copy is kept.") without passing through the signed-out screen, and Kevin's other projects stay reachable.
actual: A misleading signed-out screen that tells him to have an agent sign the browser in.
suggested_fix: When a project request returns 401 or 403 REVOKED while /session still succeeds, render the ProjectFailure revoked state instead of the signed-out screen.

criterion: Labels self-explanatory / one way per task
description: Member revocation is CLI-only and needs the person's identity ID. `client show` labels that field `humanId` next to `id` (the Actor ID) and `handle`. Passing the Actor ID returns `NOT_FOUND: Admission not found`, which gives no hint that the wrong kind of ID was used.
expected: `--id` accepts the Actor ID, handle or identity ID. Failing that, the error says "That is an Actor ID; use humanId …". Ideally Kevin's profile offers Remove from project for the creator.
actual: An opaque NOT_FOUND, and the right field is never called 'identity'.
suggested_fix: Resolve Actor IDs to their humanId in the member-revoke path, or return a hint naming the field to use.

description: The revoked screen offers Retry, which cannot succeed for a revoked membership.
expected: Only "Open another project" (and, ideally, "Export my local copy").
suggested_fix: Hide Retry when the failure code is REVOKED.

description: When the revoked person has another project, a reload opens that project and the revoked one disappears from the switcher without any notice.
expected: A one-time notice: "You no longer have access to Atlas Mobile. Your local copy is kept."
suggested_fix: Keep revoked projects in /session flagged as revoked, and show them once (or in the switcher) with an explanation.

description: "Local data remains saved" is shown, but the UI offers no way to see or export that data. Export is CLI-only and needs a project ID that `client list` no longer returns (see STORY-141).
expected: An export or view-read-only action on the revoked screen.
actual: No path from the message to the data.
suggested_fix: Add an export action to the revoked ProjectFailure state.
